name: Code graph
blurb: A repository's definitions and the references between them, resolved by the TypeScript compiler, one graph state per commit, so a pull request's branch diff shows what it changed in the call graph.
sample: hono's router, before and after a real pull request

questions.q: What breaks if I change it?
Which classes implement this interface method?
What does everything else depend on?

search.title: Code graph: compiler-resolved references for agents
